title: 👣 Step counter
promoTitle: 🚶‍♀️ Do you like strolling along the corso?
promoText:
From today you can count your steps and the calories you burn.
The more you walk, the more active you are, the more you live Serracapriola.
intro: Press START and walk: I count your steps, distance, calories and time. Keep your phone in your pocket or hand, with this page open.
profileHint: Optional: height and weight make distance and calories more accurate.
modeGps: GPS mode: walk outdoors to measure distance
noSupport: This device does not support step counting.
gpsDenied: Allow location in your browser settings to use GPS mode.

levelText.esordiente: A good start! Every step counts, keep going.
levelText.passeggiatore: Nice pace, like a good walker. Well done!
levelText.sportivo: A real athlete’s pace! Great workout.

rankingAsk: Do you want to add your distance to the ranking?
rankingError: Could not add you, please try again
tooShort: Walk at least 50 metres and 30 seconds to join the ranking.
rankingNote: You only join the ranking if you want to: it’s your choice.
